characters.continuity: Sonic the Hedgehog (Mainstream Video Game Canon)
characters.summary: Sonic relies on his extreme super-speed, acrobatic momentum, and the Homing Attack to overwhelm opponents in close-quarters combat. He uses dynamic rolling charges and spin dashes to break through heavy defenses.
weaknesses: Inability to swim in deep water
Vulnerability to sudden traps or ambushes when overconfident
limitations: Stamina drain from continuous high-speed movement without breaks
Drowning hazard in deep water due to inability to swim

sources.supports: General overview of Sonic's speed, capabilities, and abilities across the video game series.
Details on techniques such as the Homing Attack, Light Speed Dash, and overall game feats.

feats.claim: Ran around the world and bypassed obstacles at supersonic speeds.
Utilized the Homing Attack to defeat multiple enemy robots simultaneously in mid-air.

notableResults.note: Defeated Eggman's various mechs and escaping Eggmanland.
Fought to a standstill on Space Colony Ark.

campaignTags.claim: Sonic can momentarily propel himself through the air or use momentum to fly in certain game physics.

unknowns: Exact top speed unquantified numerically beyond relativistic or speed-of-sound feats depending on the specific media interpretation.

characters.summary: Darkspine Sonic channels intense fury and draws power from the World Rings of Rage, Sadness, and Hatred, allowing him to launch devastating fire-based energy attacks and fly.
weaknesses: Short-term form driven by intense negative emotional states
Dependent on the stability of the World Rings
characters.formDifferences: Transforms base Sonic into a darker, ring-powered entity wreathed in blue and white fire, granting pyrokinesis, flight, and time-manipulation abilities.

sources.supports: Darkspine Sonic form capabilities, pyrokinesis, and combat feats in Sonic and the Secret Rings.

unknowns: Whether Darkspine Sonic can be sustained outside of the Arabian Nights story context.

characters.summary: Excalibur Sonic is clad in legendary golden armor and wields the sacred sword Excalibur, allowing him to engage in heavy melee combat and deflect powerful blows.
weaknesses: Form is strictly tied to the existence and power of Excalibur and the Sacred Swords.
characters.formDifferences: Equips Sonic with legendary golden plate armor and the magical sword Excalibur, massively boosting his defense and melee striking power.

sources.supports: Excalibur Sonic form details, golden armor, and sword combat feats in Sonic and the Black Knight.

unknowns: Limits of the golden armor's durability against non-magical extreme pressures.

characters.summary: Hyper Sonic uses the power of the Super Emeralds to unleash blinding flashes of light, shattering screen-wide obstacles and moving with enhanced afterimages.

mechanisms: Absolute invulnerability to standard physical and energy attacks

weaknesses: Ring consumption timer limits duration in battle
characters.formDifferences: An upgraded version of Super Sonic achieved via Super Emeralds, featuring flashing color-changing sprites and a screen-wide enemy elimination ability.

sources.supports: Hyper Sonic mechanics, Super Emerald transformation, and screen-clearing Hyper Flash.

unknowns: Reasons for omission in later titles.

characters.summary: Sonic transforms into a beastly Werehog, trading his speed for immense physical strength, stretchable arms, and brutal wrestling-style grappling moves.

mechanisms: Thick fur providing physical damage resistance

weaknesses: Greatly reduced movement speed compared to standard Sonic
characters.formDifferences: Changes Sonic into a lumbering beast with elongated arms and beastly strength, trading speed for brute force and grappling.

sources.supports: Sonic the Werehog combat style, stretchable arms, strength, and reduced speed in Sonic Unleashed.

unknowns: Full extent of dark Gaia energy's permanence outside of nighttime conditions.

characters.continuity: Sonic the Hedgehog (Mainstream Video Game Canon)
characters.summary: Super Sonic harnesses the power of the seven Chaos Emeralds to gain invulnerability, flight, and immense golden energy projection.

mechanisms: Complete invulnerability to all standard damage sources

weaknesses: Ring-count timer dictates how long the transformation can be maintained
Requires all seven Chaos Emeralds to transform
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Sonic into a golden, golden-quilled state with unlimited flight, total invulnerability, and vastly elevated power.

sources.supports: Super Sonic invulnerability, flight, Chaos Emerald requirement, and boss fights.

campaignTags.claim: Super Sonic can freely fly through the air at high speeds.

unknowns: Upper limit of power scaling against cosmic-level deities without external amplification.

characters.summary: Sora combines Keyblade melee strikes, elemental magic spells, and agile acrobatic maneuvers. He adapts to opponents using Drive Forms and situational Keyblade transformations.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to magic depletion (MP recharge state)
Susceptible to mental manipulation and emotional targeting
limitations: MP gauge limits consecutive magic spellcasting until recharged
Drive forms have time limits before causing exhaustion

sources.supports: Sora's overview, Keyblade weapon, and magic capabilities in Kingdom Hearts.
Detailed list of Sora's abilities, Drive Forms, magic spells, and combat feats.

feats.claim: Defeated numerous Heartless, Nobody, and Disney villains using Keyblade combat.
Survived clashes with Xemnas and Xehanort utilizing various Drive Forms and magic.
feats.citation: Kingdom Hearts II / Kingdom Hearts III

notableResults.note: Defeated with assistance from Riku after a prolonged dual battle.

campaignTags.claim: Sora casts offensive and defensive spells like Fire, Thunder, and Cura.
Sora relies on magic as a primary combat resource alongside his physical weapon.

unknowns: Exact power scaling of the Power of Waking when used in combat scenarios.

characters.summary: Spyro attacks opponents using fiery breath, aerial charges, and tail whips. He uses his small size and wings to dart around opponents and evade attacks.
weaknesses: Low physical mass compared to large adversaries
Vulnerable to hazards when glide momentum fails
limitations: Glide duration is limited before descending to the ground
Elemental breaths sometimes require specific rune or gem power-ups depending on the game

sources.supports: Spyro's basic abilities, flame breath, and gameplay style across the series.
Comprehensive overview of Spyro's elemental breaths, charges, and combat actions.

feats.claim: Defeated Gnasty Gnork and Ripto using a combination of flame breath and charging.
feats.citation: Spyro the Dragon / Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage!

notableResults.note: Pursued and defeated across multiple worlds.

campaignTags.claim: Spyro breathes streams and projectiles of fire at enemies.
Spyro generates and directs fire from his mouth at will.
Spyro uses his wings to glide across gaps and maintain brief aerial movement.

unknowns: Discrepancies between Classic Spyro's simple fire breath and Legend of Spyro's multi-elemental mastery.

characters.summary: Sub-Zero utilizes cryomancy to freeze opponents, construct ice weapons, and control the battlefield. He combines martial arts strikes with devastating ice projectiles.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to extreme heat environments that melt ice constructs
Close-range brawlers who bypass zoning projectiles
mobility: Standard foot speed and martial arts dashes
limitations: Ice generation requires precise control and focus

sources.supports: Sub-Zero's history, cryomancer abilities, and role in Mortal Kombat.
Detailed breakdown of Sub-Zero's ice powers, special moves, and notable fights.

feats.claim: Froze and shattered multiple Lin Kuei assassins and tournament fighters.
Defeated Scorpion in mortal combat during various timeline encounters.

notableResults.note: Their rivalry spans multiple wins and losses on both sides across timelines.

campaignTags.claim: Sub-Zero generates and manipulates ice for combat.
Sub-Zero freezes opponents and constructs projectiles and statues out of ice.
Sub-Zero forms swords, daggers, and axes out of solid ice to strike opponents.

unknowns: Exact biological limits of his Lin Kuei cybernetic augmentation vs human cryomancer heritage across different timelines.

characters.summary: James P. Sullivan ('Sully') relies on immense brute strength, heavy physical size, and terrifying roars to intimidate opponents in close-quarters brawls.

mechanisms: Thick fur and heavy blubbery hide

weaknesses: Lack of ranged projectiles or magic
Gentle disposition unless provoked into defense
limitations: Slow movement speed over long distances
No training in formal martial arts

feats.claim: Scared numerous children with a single thunderous roar.

campaignTags.claim: Sully stands over 8 feet tall with massive physical bulk.
